title: Exact Two-Dimensional SU(2) Yang-Mills in Lean: Weyl Integration, Heat-Kernel Convolution, Migdal Invariance, and the Exact Simple-Loop Area Law
author: Lluis Eriksson
headline: SUPERSEDED BY AI.VIXRA:2607.0039V1 FOR THE ORIGINAL-EDGE AND TREE-COTREE CLOSURE
summary: This replacement preserves public version 1 and corrects its publication-level scope. Version 1 proves the compact-group analytic chain, exact heat-kernel reductions, schedule independence and finite reduced-model statements, but its own pages 7 and 9 leave open the bridge from the post-gauge-fixed evaluator to the original-edge physical integral for arbitrary cellulations.

The missing original-edge gauge-fixing, simultaneous face-holonomy transport and compatible primal-tree/dual-tree closure are supplied by ai.viXra:2607.0039v1. That successor is therefore the authoritative source for the full exact simple-loop area-law theorem at the stated finite two-dimensional SU(2) heat-kernel scope.
citation_rule: For the full original-edge finite-cellulation theorem and exact simple-loop area law, cite ai.viXra:2607.0039v1. Version 1 of this record may be cited for its reduced schedule and analytic precursor results only, together with this notice.
status_boundary: The correction narrows an overbroad title/abstract reading; it does not retract the compact-group identities or reduced schedule theorem. Neither record constructs four-dimensional continuum Yang-Mills theory or proves a four-dimensional mass gap.
retained: Transported Haar/spherical probability, character convolution and heat-kernel semigroup identities at the stated finite SU(2) scope.
Certified dual-graph elimination schedules and schedule-independent reduced amplitudes.
The explicit three-face and arbitrary-valence local gauge-fixing constructions within their printed scope.
superseded: The claim that version 1 alone closes the arbitrary-cellulation original-edge physical integral.
Use of the version 1 title/abstract as authority for the full simple-loop theorem despite the limitations stated on pages 7 and 9.
The stray public metadata suffix 'Author(s)', which is not part of the PDF title.
successor_adds: A rooted spanning-tree gauge fixing on the original physical edge variables with product-Haar preservation.
Simultaneous transport of all facial holonomies and removal of tree/gauge coordinates from the heat-kernel density.
A compatible tree-cotree closure and equality of the original-edge amplitude with the total-area heat kernel.
evidence: The retained and successor claims are machine-certified exact finite-cellulation statements as reported by their pinned Lean artifacts. This audit verified the public PDFs and claim boundary; it did not rerun the full Lean project.
provenance: Notice pages 1-2 are new. The following nine pages reproduce public version 1 with identical rendered content. Frozen copies of version 1 and the ten-page public successor are included in the package.
